searchText: Hello, where can I track the progress of sharding? The merge and sharding still being worked on in parallel? <@!579635690359488515> The merge R&D has priority, but sharding is being worked on in parallel, and already has a specification. See https://rayonism.io for latest testnet efforts. latest core specs are here -- https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/blob/dev/specs/sharding/beacon-chain.md general structure is correct but lacks in depth testing and as proto mentioned, might see some proof-of-concepts built on merge testnets soon The discord is too large, please keep channels as much on-topic as possible. Direct spam/etc. reports to <#595721451651465227>
